subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should #38730 stay open until the configurable cron.minInterval guardrail and guarded cron base-session retention slices land or are rejected, or should maintainers split the remaining context/session warning work now?
rationale: The source-backed gaps are real, but the cadence guardrail adds a core config/product contract and the retention fix changes compatibility-sensitive session lifecycle cleanup semantics.

options.title: Keep Open For Linked Slices
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while reviewing #89739 and #90194, then split only any leftover context-threshold or cleanup warnings.

options.title: Split Remaining Guardrails Now
options.body: Create narrower canonical issues for context-threshold warnings and sessions-cleanup behavior, leaving each open PR to close only its slice.

options.title: Reject Core Cadence Guardrail
options.body: If maintainers do not want cron.minInterval or default warnings in core, close or narrow the cadence work and keep only the retention bug path.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Linked Slices
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while reviewing #89739 and #90194, then split only any leftover context-threshold or cleanup warnings.
